content: forge CLI v0.1 subset (design Appendix B): forge new (manifest+lockfile+skill pin), forge check [item] (run ladder, structured per-obligation JSON results). Parse Verus/Z3 output into the stable JSON schema (design 5.1): each obligation -> {address, status, level, solver_time_ms, counterexample?}. Counterexamples come from the solver, never just 'failed'. Reserve a suggested_move slot. forge goal/fill (incremental holes) are OUT of v0.1 scope.
